solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Storm is uncovered about tabloid

indicators.note: about means going around, so one word is wrapped round the other here

parts.note: uncovered means bare, exposed
a rag is a disparaging name for a tabloid newspaper

explanation.surface: A sensational newspaper finds itself exposed in a storm of criticism.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrage is an overwhelming outpouring, like a storm of questions or protests.

clue.text: A couple in GB upset about topless pub in terrible disorder?

indicators.note: about means wrapped around, so the jumbled letters enclose the cut-down word
upset means overturned and disordered, so the letters are rearranged
topless means losing the top, the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A British couple are upset about a bar with no top in a dreadful mess.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the 'disorder' is a medical one, not a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: The bubonic plague was a deadly epidemic illness, so literally a terrible disorder of the body.

clue.text: No defender of the status quo spoke about Cuba

definitions.text: No defender of the status quo

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece is put round the other

parts.note: a radial is a spoke radiating from a centre
C is the international vehicle code for Cuba

explanation.surface: A revolutionary addressed the subject of Cuba.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoke' looks like a verb but is the noun, a wheel's radial.
explanation.definitionFit: A radical wants sweeping change, so is the opposite of a conservative.

clue.text: Well-built model deprived of sun

indicators.note: deprived of means losing something, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a sample is a representative specimen or model

explanation.surface: A muscular model kept out of the sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Ample describes a large, generous figure, a synonym for a solidly built person.

clue.text: Service still no good

parts.note: still in the sense of nevertheless, even so

explanation.surface: A church service remains disappointing.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the Anglican evening prayer service.

clue.text: Like time in Washington DC in summary

parts.note: to dig something is slang for liking it
EST is Eastern Standard Time, the clock used in Washington DC

explanation.surface: Someone compares a summary to the pace of life in the American capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Like' is a verb here, not a comparison: DIG is slang for enjoy.
explanation.definitionFit: A digest is a condensed version of longer material, a synonym for a summary.

clue.text: Useless type with desire uncovered to be like a dandy

parts.note: a dud is a useless person or thing

indicators.note: uncovered means its top is taken off, so the first letter goes

parts.note: a wish is a desire

explanation.surface: A useless person whose longing is exposed wants to be a fop.
explanation.definitionFit: A dude was originally a fastidious, dressy man, so dudish means foppish.

clue.text: Game trailed by inventor certainly has come to an end

indicators.note: trailed by means followed by, so the pieces are placed one after the other

parts.note: go is the Japanese board game
Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone
yup is a casual way of saying yes, certainly

explanation.surface: A game finished after the inventor said yes.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to fail or die, like a fish floating upside down, so to end.

clue.text: Note opening above water?

parts.note: sol is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale
a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: A note about a hole above the waterline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'above water' is financial: keeping your head above water means paying debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Being solvent means having enough money to pay debts, idiomatically keeping afloat financially.

clue.text: English county beginning to promote study in retirement coverage?

parts.note: Beds is the short form of Bedfordshire, an English county

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, so only the start of promote is used

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: An English county promotes study as part of its pension coverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retirement' is going to bed, not leaving work, so the coverage is a blanket.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedspread covers a bed, and retiring means going to bed, so it is cover for the retired.

clue.text: Temperature adopted in Asian island for Indian food

indicators.note: something adopted is taken in, so one letter goes inside the island's name

parts.note: Bali is an Indonesian island

explanation.surface: An Asian island takes up a dish from India.
explanation.definitionFit: A balti is a spiced curry cooked and served in a metal pan, from the Indian subcontinent cuisine.

clue.text: Imply internet is faulty in a cheeky way

indicators.note: faulty means not working properly, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Suggesting the web is broken would be rude.
explanation.definitionFit: Impertinently means rudely or disrespectfully, which is how a cheeky person behaves.

clue.text: Highly specialised hotel in Mediterranean resort

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A specialist hotel on the Riviera.
explanation.definitionFit: Niche is used as an adjective for products or markets aimed at a small specialised group.

clue.text: Slim shape is constructed as element in a painter?

indicators.note: constructed means built up afresh, so the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: An artist's slender figure is built up as a component of the picture.
explanation.walkthrough: A painter is also the rope that ties up a small boat; that rope can be made of this fibre.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisal hemp is a strong plant fibre used in rope, and a painter is a mooring rope.

clue.text: Young athlete rushed close to fine Scottish actor

parts.note: a colt is a young, inexperienced sports player
rushed means ran

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter, taken here from fine

explanation.surface: A young sprinter hurries to finish well.
explanation.definitionFit: Robbie Coltrane was a Scottish actor known for Cracker and as Hagrid in Harry Potter.

clue.text: Reasoning in temperance movement's slogan?

definitions.meaning: the logic or justification behind a decision
split in two, the word reads as a call to limit beer that an anti-drink campaign might adopt

explanation.surface: The thinking behind an anti-drink campaign's motto.
explanation.definitionFit: A rationale is the set of reasons underlying an action or belief.

clue.text: Story made up about European that's often in bed?

indicators.note: about means going round, so the jumbled letters surround the extra one
made up means invented, so the letters of story are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tall tale about a continental who spends much time lying down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made up' turns STORY into OYSTR; 'about' puts E inside it. The bed is a seabed.
explanation.definitionFit: Oysters are farmed and grow on oyster beds on the sea floor.

clue.text: By the sound of it, couple fall for sweet

indicators.note: signals that the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a couple is a pair and to fall is to drop

explanation.surface: Two people falling over for a sugary treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A pear drop is a boiled sweet shaped like a pear and tasting of fruit.

clue.text: Spot couple at ground, not at college

indicators.note: ground means crushed and broken down, so the letters are rearranged
not tells us to leave the following letters out

parts.note: up means in residence at university, as in going up to Oxford

explanation.surface: Pick out a pair on the field who are not at university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes UP from COUPLE, leaving COLE; 'ground' rearranges COLE plus AT.
explanation.definitionFit: To spot something is to find where it is, the verb's meaning of pinpointing.

clue.text: Establish first of cricketers in form after knock

indicators.note: first of means the opening letter of the word
after a knock things are dislodged, so the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Cricketers are back in good shape after a decent innings.
explanation.walkthrough: A knock is a batting innings in cricket, but here it jumbles IN FORM.
explanation.definitionFit: To confirm something is to establish it as true or settled.

clue.text: Noted Florentine loves Puccini essentially

indicators.note: essentially means at the core, so the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A famous man from Florence adores the opera composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Amerigo Vespucci was a Florentine navigator whose name gave America its name.

clue.text: Hide a line put under chapter previously

indicators.note: in a down answer, what is put under comes later, so the order is set

parts.note: once means formerly, previously

explanation.surface: Bury a line beneath an earlier chapter.
explanation.definitionFit: To conceal is to keep out of sight, a synonym of hide as a verb.

clue.text: Politician engaged in awful lies is easily understood

indicators.note: engaged in means involved within, so one piece goes inside
awful suggests something badly made, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician caught up in terrible untruths is easy to read.
explanation.definitionFit: Simple means plain and uncomplicated, so easy to grasp.

clue.text: Punter's doing role playing

definitions.note: read as punter is, so the definition is a noun phrase: a punter

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are being played around with, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gambler is taking on a part in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Punter' suggests a gambler, but here it is someone who propels a boat with a pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A gondolier propels a Venetian boat, much as a punter poles a punt.

clue.text: Offensive weapon in manner of speaking not normal

indicators.note: not tells us the following letters are left out

parts.note: parlance is a particular way of speaking
par means normal, as in feeling below par

explanation.surface: Calling something an offensive weapon is an unusual turn of phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A lance is a long spear used by mounted soldiers in attack.

clue.text: Composer, tragic figure capturing hearts

indicators.note: capturing means holding within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: King Lear is Shakespeare's tragic hero
H is the card abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: A tragic figure wins hearts as a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Lehár was the Hungarian composer of The Merry Widow.

clue.text: Musical relatively free of trappings on reflection

indicators.note: a reflection shows things back to front, so the letters are read backwards
trappings are the outer trimmings, so the outer letters of relatively are dropped

explanation.surface: A musical seems comparatively unencumbered when you think about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free of trappings' strips REL and LY to leave ATIVE; 'on reflection' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita is the Lloyd Webber and Rice stage show about Eva Perón.

clue.text: Paper replaced such leading chaps in part

indicators.note: in places the other pieces within this one

parts.note: arch means chief or leading, as in arch-rival
chaps are men

explanation.surface: Paper took over, and top men are among the cast.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers to itself: paper supplanted this older writing material.
explanation.definitionFit: Parchment, prepared animal skin, was the writing surface that paper came to supplant.

clue.text: Obstruct young devil facing garden no end

parts.note: an imp is a little devil

indicators.note: no end means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: Eden is the biblical garden

explanation.surface: Stop a little mischief-maker from confronting an endless garden.
explanation.definitionFit: To impede is to hinder progress, the same action as obstructing.

clue.text: Talk about special seasoning

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a parley is a talk between opposing sides

explanation.surface: A conversation about special flavouring.
explanation.definitionFit: Parsley is a herb used to flavour and garnish food.
